text:
maria: Quick heads-up — multiple PR evals failing on GH Actions with "no such file" when trying to download shard artifact metadata. Intermittent on self-hosted runners.
alex: saw same. failure rate ~7% on main PR matrix in the last hour.
samir: can you paste a snippet of the runner logs?
maria: here's the upload/download bit I grabbed:```error: unable to download artifact /tmp/eval-shard-123.json: 404```
alex: looks like artifact path contains double slashes when upstream container writes to /tmp/ and actions upload strips leading slash.
toni: hmm could be our artifact-shim helper writing absolute paths. I can reproduce locally with gha-runner v2.300.
ci-bot: created issue #3584 with attached logs and queue traces.
samir: short-term mitigation: change GH workflow to run a small "gather-artifacts" step in the same job before upload to canonicalize paths. also add a tiny smoke job as a PR gate to catch this early.
maria: can we instead update eval-runner to always upload artifacts with relative paths? safer long term.
alex: agree, but runner change needs rollout testing; let's do workflow mitigation first so PR gating isn't flaky.
toni: propose workflow change: add job `pr-eval-smoke` that runs on ubuntu-latest and executes a 1-shard quant-smoke, then uploads artifact via actions/upload-artifact with explicit relative path. snippet:```uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
with:
  name: eval-shard
  path: ./out/shard-*.json```
maria: also add jitter to nightly cron: current schedules all start at 00:00 UTC causing thundering herd on shared runners.
samir: agreed — I'll add a random minute offset to the schedule matrix for nightly runs.
ops-bot: CI change request submitted: CI-PIPE-389 — update gha workflow and add schedule jitter.
alex: one more ask: add a metric to the console/dashboard for PR-gate artifact failures (5xx + 404s) broken down by runner pool so we can monitor root cause.
maria: i've opened a dashboard todo in #eng-platform and tagged @toni for the runner normalization patch.
toni: I'll raise a small PR to normalize artifact paths in the eval-runner and a separate GH workflow PR for the smoke job + cron jitter.
samir: thanks — i'll watch the pipelines and enable buildkite fallback on flaky PRs if GH keeps failing.
maria: :thumbsup: i'll follow up tomorrow with failure rate numbers and CI logs.
